headline: BGMEA asks garment factories to verify workers' ID cards before entry
summary: The Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association has asked factories to verify workers' ID cards before entry. The workers' primary demand is raising the monthly minimum wage from Tk12,500 to Tk30,000.
why: The BGMEA is the main trade body for Bangladesh's garment exporters, and wage and labour disputes in the sector can affect production and export volumes.
